claim_being_audited: That certifying the model for launch is compliant and evidentially supported on aggregate readiness grounds despite the unresolved Spanish-language billing support gap.

concern_ledger.concern: No admissible evidence shows the named segment limitation was disclosed before launch.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Launch disclosure or model-card evidence explicitly covering the Spanish-language billing support gap.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy requires disclosure for material limitations unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.

concern_ledger.concern: No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance for the unresolved named use-case limitation.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Documented approval of risk acceptance applicable to this release and this specific segment gap.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Approved risk acceptance is one of the explicit policy paths to launch when a material limitation is unresolved.

concern_ledger.concern: Legal review on disclosure remains open.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Final legal determination or equivalent admissible evidence resolving the disclosure obligation.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Pending legal review preserves uncertainty on whether a required disclosure predicate has been satisfied; policy text says pending legal review does not resolve materiality.

concern_ledger.concern: Actor overrelies on aggregate readiness and public governance guidance to support certification.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Admissible evidence satisfying one of the policy predicates: resolution, disclosure, or approved risk acceptance.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Those points do not independently satisfy the specific release-policy requirement triggered by a material limitation in a named launch use case.

decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence satisfies the policy threshold for certification.
A weakness is material if it affects a contractual customer segment, protected segment, or named launch use case.
Product labels such as non-core or low-volume do not resolve materiality when the segment is named in customer commitments or legal review is pending.
For a material limitation in a named launch use case, compliance requires evidence that it was resolved, disclosed, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Public governance guidance can support documentation and monitoring expectations but cannot substitute for the specific policy predicates required here.
evidence_requests: Provide admissible evidence that the Spanish-language billing support gap was disclosed in the model card or equivalent launch disclosure before certification.
Provide admissible evidence of an approved pre-launch risk acceptance covering this named use-case limitation.
Provide admissible evidence that the gap was resolved before launch, including updated evaluation results for the affected segment.
Provide the final legal determination on the disclosure question if it exists.
specific_concerns: Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support general launch readiness but do not resolve the policy condition for a material limitation in a named launch use case.
The affected Spanish-language billing support segment is named in three international pilot commitments, which supports materiality under the policy text.
The release policy requires disclosure unless the limitation is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch, and neither predicate is evidenced.
Legal review on whether disclosure is required remains open, so the disclosure predicate is unresolved.
Public guidance on documenting limitations and monitoring risk is governance context, not affirmative evidence that certification without disclosure or approved risk acceptance is compliant.
unsupported_claims: The action is compliant as proposed based on admissible evidence alone.
Public governance guidance is sufficient to justify certification notwithstanding the unresolved policy-triggering limitation.
Product's non-core characterization resolves or defeats materiality.
